Fixes bug fix-repro-test-id-option-py312: On Python 3.12.3 (GitHub runner) pytest's argparse mishandles '--': 'pytest -- --co' is collect-only, exit 5 'no tests collected', not exit 4 'not found'. test_a_test_id_that_looks_like_an_option_is_not_one failed in CI (publish.yml verify). Reproduced with python3.12.3 + pytest 9.1.1. Fix: check the path ourselves, ./-prefix a dash id, scrub PYTEST_ADDOPTS/XDIST env.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-fix-repro-test-id-option-py312 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed fix-repro-test-id-option-py312 --regression-test <test>` first).

data.body: WHAT: the 'Test before publishing' step (uv run pytest tests/ -q --timeout=420 -n auto, publish.yml verify job) took 5116 s (1:25:16): 12720 passed, 1 failed, 29 skipped on a ubuntu-latest runner (Python 3.12.3, xdist 3.8.0). Slower than the 1:17:46 in fix-ci-split-slow-tests. Not a duplicate: it adds that publish.yml's verify job also runs the full suite (a second copy of ci.yml's) and gates every publish on it; both fix-ci-split-slow-tests (split slow tests, budget, timeout-minutes) and fix-test-duration-profile (where the time goes) apply, and this should follow them: decide whether verify re-runs the full suite or reuses the ci.yml result for the same sha. NOT fixed here. ACCEPTANCE: verify's test step wall time reported before/after; budget from a workflow variable.
data.title: CI test step took 85 minutes on the GitHub runner
